fixtures.label: Order 841
fixtures.description: Single-destination order with rentals, tax, and replacement costs (destination-scoped dates). Real catalog items and prices; the organization and billing address are synthetic — the delivery address is a public shopping centre.

fixtures.label: Multi-destination
fixtures.description: Two destinations — customer-collecting from our counter (charge window == delivery window) plus a we-deliver stage with a divergent charge window — exercises per-destination titles, legend variants, the conditional charge row, and both nesting levels (a line item directly under a destination, and a group). Items, prices and taxes are drawn from real orders; the organization, contacts and instructions are invented and both addresses are public corporate venues, so the fixture is PII-free by construction and is NOT run through applyPii.

fixtures.label: Discounts + transaction fee
fixtures.description: The money-coverage fixture: a percent discount, a flat (dollars-per-unit) discount, and a percent_of_total transaction fee — the three shapes no other fixture exercises, which left 5 of quote.eta's 19 it.currency sites in branches nothing renders. Every money value is computed by @cfs/core/utils/orders rather than typed by hand. Organization, contacts and instructions are invented and the address is a public venue, so it is PII-free by construction.

fixtures.label: Service only, untaxed
fixtures.description: The 6-column floor: the only fixture that drops BOTH the Duration and the Tax column. One untaxed service line, no rental anywhere, no discount — so every conditional column in the items grid is off and the header is just Item Description / Type / Qty / Unit Price / Subtotal / Total. Note it is NOT "the only fixture without tax" — rental-discount-exempt drops Tax too but keeps Duration. Captured from prod order 977.

fixtures.label: Taxed sale, no rentals
fixtures.description: 7 columns — Tax on, Duration and Discount off. A single taxed sale line and no rental anywhere, so this is the only fixture that renders a Tax column with NO Duration column beside it, and the only one whose grid is exactly one conditional wide. Captured from prod order 992.

fixtures.label: Discounted rentals, tax exempt
fixtures.description: 8 columns via Duration + Discount with Tax OFF — the only fixture that lays a Discount column out with no Tax column next to it, because the organization is tax_exempt and totals.taxes is empty. Two of its five rentals are 100% discounted, so subtotal_discounted_cents is 0: the falsy-zero case that made `||` print the pre-discount subtotal. Also carries two sibling groups under one destination. templates#69 listed this order as 9 columns; measured 2026-08-14 it is 8. Captured from prod order 989.

fixtures.label: Taxed rental, no discount
fixtures.description: 8 columns via Duration + Tax with Discount OFF — the commonest real shape (a taxed rental order nobody discounted) and the only fixture in the family that renders it. templates#69 dropped this order believing mixed-two-tax-rates covered the same combination; measured 2026-08-14 that order carries a 100%-discounted line and renders 9 columns, so without this entry the set had no Duration+Tax 8-column case at all and the two 8-column shapes collapsed to one. Deliberately minimal — one rental in one group — because its job is the column combination, not content. Captured from prod order 991.
